description: This class includes the manufacture of telephone and data communications equipment.
includes: manufacture of central office switching equipment
manufacture of mobile telephones and smartphones
manufacture of telephone and facsimile equipment
manufacture of private branch exchange (PBX) equipment
manufacture of radio and TV broadcasting and wireless communications equipment
manufacture of radio transmitters and receivers
manufacture of closed circuit television equipment
manufacture of antennas and antenna reflectors
manufacture of high speed data transmitters and receivers
excludes: manufacture of electronic components for communications equipment, see 2610
manufacture of consumer audio and video equipment, see 2640
